source.paper: Quantum error correction below the surface code threshold

gate: forgeries_accepted MUST be 0 on hardware syndromes as on simulated ones
scope: the certification RATE is an empirical property of this device, this error model and this decoder; SOUNDNESS is a property of the checker and does not depend on any of them
